The user is asking which approach is better: (1) building a distributed engine on top of Merge Engine which sits on ReplicatedMergeTree, or (2) building Merge Engine on top of a distributed engine which sits on merge tree. This is a conceptual question about database architecture and engine organization in ClickHouse.
